results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller context `msg.sender` (expected `address(prizeToken)`), `operator` (expected `factory`), `from` (expected `sponsor`), and `tokenId` (expected `prizeTokenId`), with `bytes calldata` ignored, satisfy the guard and control the emitted `PrizeDeposited(msg.sender, tokenId, from)` event fields while triggering the state transition `status = Status.Active` and returning `IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector`.
results.flow_security_relevance: Transitions the raffle clone from `Status.AwaitingPrize` to `Status.Active` without a `nonReentrant` modifier or an in-hook `prizeToken.ownerOf(prizeTokenId) == address(this)` check, immediately enabling `Status.Active` entrypoints (`buyEntries`, `requestDraw`, `enableRefunds`) during the external `prizeToken.safeTransferFrom` execution and relying on `RaffleFactory.createRaffle` post-call checks (`prize.ownerOf(params.prizeTokenId) == raffle` and `IRaffle(raffle).status() == IRaffle.Status.Active`) to enforce actual NFT custody.
results.flow_summary: When invoked on a `Raffle` clone in `Status.AwaitingPrize` by the configured `prizeToken` contract with `tokenId == prizeTokenId`, `from == sponsor`, and `operator == factory` (such as during `RaffleFactory.createRaffle`'s `safeTransferFrom`), `onERC721Received` transitions `status` to `Status.Active`, emits `PrizeDeposited`, and returns the `IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector` acceptance magic value.
results.flow_terminal_action: Mutates storage `status = Status.Active`, emits `PrizeDeposited(msg.sender, tokenId, from)`, and returns `IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector` (`0x150b7a02`).
